statement: A guard's tests can pass while the guard is disabled, when the defect is in which copy runs rather than in the code: cejel's closed-name checker already diffed base...head from given revisions, so tests of the checker alone were green under a workflow that ran the pull request's own checker and list. Rule: when a guard must not be judged by the change it judges, make the behavioural tests read the shipped workflow to decide which side's copy to run, show the head's own copy is defeated, and require the selected copy to fail it.

A diff-reading guard that runs in a checkout of the pull request inherits that pull request's .gitattributes: a change that marks its files -diff makes git print 'Binary files differ', and the guard reads no added lines. The defect report named the list, the checker and the workflow; the checkout's attributes were a fourth input from the same untrusted side. Rule: when moving a guard to the base copy, list everything the checkout supplies (config, attributes, hooks, tests), not only the files the report names, and test each.
